name: GOAT Sample
note: A representative GOAT-format (April 2005) control list plus a small Extra Deck, purely as a worked example of the extra/format schema. All names verified against cards.cdb.
sources: [GF-FUS] GoatFormat.com, "Fusions in Goat Format": https://www.goatformat.com/home/fusions-in-goat-format (level-by-level Metamorphosis targets; TER / Dark Balter / Ryu Senshi / Reaper on the Nightmare / Master of Oz / Giltia roles)

[GF-BASICS] GoatFormat.com, "Basic Mechanics": https://www.goatformat.com/basics.html (GOAT priority — the turn player may activate a monster's Ignition Effect after a Summon resolves, before the opponent responds)

[GR] Goat Format Rulings: https://goatrulings.com/goat-indv-rulings/metamorphosis.html and https://goatrulings.com/goat-indv-rulings/thousand-eyes-restrict.html (Tokens are legal Metamorphosis material; no matching Level = cannot activate; not a proper Fusion Summon; TER equip is a targeting effect that fizzles if TER is flipped face-down)
[GF-GOAT] GoatFormat.com, "Goat Control": https://www.goatformat.com/goat-control.html (Scapegoat token -> Metamorphosis -> Thousand-Eyes Restrict; TER + Tsukuyomi board control)

[GF-BAN] Goat Format Forbidden & Restricted List: https://goatformat.wordpress.com/the-goat-format-forbidden-and-restricted-list/ (Magical Scientist is Forbidden; mirrored at https://goatworld.community/wiki/banlist)

[GW] GoatWorld, "Goat Format Staples" and "Goat Control Deck Guide": https://goatworld.community/blog/goat-format-staples-must-have-cards-explained and https://goatworld.community/blog/goat-control-complete-deck-guide (Dark Balter off Airknight Parshath; activate Scapegoat in the opponent's End Phase)

manual:
GOAT control: grind card advantage, then close with a fat beater.
Key combo: Scapegoat into Metamorphosis — tribute one Sheep Token to Special Summon Thousand-Eyes Restrict, then absorb their best monster.
Open with Pot of Greed / Graceful Charity / Delinquent Duo to dig; hold Heavy Storm and Mystical Space Typhoon for their backrow.
Trade with Tribe-Infecting Virus, Breaker, and Airknight Parshath; recur threats with Premature Burial and Call of the Haunted.
Protect the combo with Book of Moon and the trap suite (Mirror Force, Torrential Tribute, Ring of Destruction).

=== EXTRA DECK ===

**One door: `Metamorphosis` — "Tribute 1 monster. Special Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck with the same Level as the Tributed monster" [CDB].** No `Polymerization`, no `Cyber-Stein`; `Magical Scientist` is **Forbidden** in GOAT [GF-BAN]. Tokens are legal material ("including a Sheep Token from `Scapegoat`"), Metamorphosis "cannot be activated" if no Fusion in the list matches the tributed monster's Level, and it "does not properly Summon a Fusion Monster, so you cannot use `Monster Reborn` on it afterwards" [GR].

**Fodder by Level — Lv1:** Sheep Token, `Sinister Serpent`, `Magician of Faith`. **Lv5:** `Airknight Parshath`. **Lv6:** nothing.

- **`Thousand-Eyes Restrict` (Lv1)** — "the most frequent and most powerful fusion monster special summoned with Metamorphosis … it can take the opponent's best monster while locking down the field at the same time" [GF-FUS]. Timing: activate `Scapegoat` in the opponent's End Phase, never on your own turn unless forced, because Scapegoat stops you Summoning the turn you play it [GW]; convert a token the turn after. Then **absorb with priority** — in GOAT rules "when a Chain or Summon has finished resolving, the turn player can activate a fast effect *or a monster's Ignition Effect* before the opponent is allowed to respond" [GF-BASICS], so equip the instant Metamorphosis resolves, before `Book of Moon` can land; if they flip it down first, TER "needs to be face up on the field to attach a monster to itself, so its effect will fizzle" [GR]. Note it locks *your* board too, and monsters equipped to TER "do not have effects and are treated as Equip Spell Cards" [GR], so it blanks what it steals.
- **`Reaper on the Nightmare` (Lv5) — a closer, not a board card:** "Mostly used in the rare situations where you control a level 5 monster that is not `Airknight Parshath` … and need to use Metamorphosis in order to push through the last bit of damage to close out a game" [GF-FUS]. It attacks your opponent directly even through their monsters, forces a random discard when it connects, and is not destroyed by battle [CDB]. ⚠ In *this* build `Airknight Parshath` is the only Level 5 — i.e. the exact case the guide says you would normally *not* convert. Make Reaper only when the game is already in lethal range and Airknight is walled, and remember any targeting Spell/Trap/monster effect destroys Reaper outright [CDB].
- **`Ryu Senshi` (Lv6) — no native fodder:** "the most commonly used level 6 fusion monster, and it [is] mostly used for setting up kill turns via Chaos Sorcerer+Metamorphosis" [GF-FUS], but this list plays no Level 6 monster. `Premature Burial` and `Call of the Haunted` target *your* Graveyard only, and `Creature Swap` has "each player choose 1 monster they control" [CDB] — so neither gets you there; `Snatch Steal` on an opposing Level 6 is the only route. When you do land it: it pays 1000 LP to negate a **Normal Trap** (`Mirror Force`, `Torrential Tribute`, `Sakuretsu Armor`, `Ring of Destruction` — *not* the Counter Trap `Solemn Judgment`) and "negate[s] the effects of any Spell Card that targets this card and destroy[s] it" [CDB], walking through `Book of Moon` and `Snatch Steal`.
